final_assessment: Proposed program-signoff in consume mode from its exploration, which had no open question: five live rules, all accounted (D-ps-1, D-ps-3, D-ps-5, D-ps-7 DERIVED; D-ps-6 SOURCED), carried as normative tables into seven delta specs. The change measured seven capabilities and fifteen requirements against ceilings of three and twelve; the user chose to declare rather than split, since "only under change" is restated across five specs and arc-done is defined in orbit-pr-lifecycle. Two requirements are renamed (the sign-off setting, and the reader taking the account), every baseline pointer to their old titles lying in a carried block; the merges were rehearsed through buildUpdatedSpec. Four ledger entries record the propose-time calls: the program hold's report shape, when a program counts as finished and done, a failed save under program asking nothing, and each sign-off needing its own setting value.
